question: Which instrument is played by Pandit Ravi Shankar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** was a world-renowned Indian musician and composer who played the **sitar**.
 
• He is credited with popularizing Indian classical music in the Western world.
 
• Shankar was born on 7 April 1920 and passed away on 11 December 2012.
 
• He was awarded India's highest civilian honor, the **Bharat Ratna**, in **1999**.
 
• His influence extended beyond music to cultural diplomacy, bridging the gap between Indian and Western music traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravi Shankar** collaborated with many Western musicians, including **George Harrison** of The Beatles, which significantly increased the global appreciation of Indian classical music.
 
• He established the **Kinnara School of Music** in Mumbai and Los Angeles to teach Indian classical music.
 
• Shankar's autobiography, **"Raga Mala,"** provides a detailed account of his life and musical journey.
 
• He also composed music for films, including **Satyajit Ray's** acclaimed Apu Trilogy.
 
• His daughter, **Anoushka Shankar**, continues his legacy as a prominent sitar player.
